mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 550 units, indicating renewed demand for housing, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 550, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 7.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the strengthening labor market boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger is met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter, indicating reduced supply chain pressures, leads to increased profit margins and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the level of real disposable income (RSAFS) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as increased income boosts consumer spending.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly correlated with RSAFS levels (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, the tightening monetary cycle increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of a falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth (above 150,000) in a month signals a strengthening labor market, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger is met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2% in a quarter, indicating robust demand, leads to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high GDPC1 growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
